newsitem.title: UK: BT weak on Cegetel stake cost worries.
newsitem.headline: BT weak on Cegetel stake cost worries.

text.p: Shares in telecommunications group British Telecom Plc were weaker in a rising market on Friday on what traders called modest profit-taking in the wake of BT's move to take a stake in France's Cegetel.

"The stock gained a little on that deal yesterday because it was good strategic news...but it could be bad financially since it might delete around 100 million stg from 1997/98 results," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
The analyst noted, however, that the cost was minimal when compared to BT's earnings and revenue power.
BT shares were down 6-1/2p at 369p by 1102 GMT.
Marketmakers said they were unconcerned about the deal, which should reap long-term benefits, but said some investors appeared to have worries about the cost.
Analysts said on Thursday the deal was not likely to prompt any earnings revisions on BT.
